seoTitle: PDF Text Extractor API: text, metadata & links from PDF URLs
seoDescription: Extract text, page ranges, RAG chunks, metadata and links from PDF URLs (incl. Drive/Dropbox links) as JSON. $0.004 per PDF, no per-page fee, failures free.

pdf-processed.eventDescription: One PDF downloaded and its text, per-page text, optional RAG chunks, metadata and links extracted (up to the configured page limit or page range). Page ranges, passwords and share-link resolution are included. Unreachable URLs, non-PDF responses, oversized or password-rejected files and scanned PDFs without a text layer are not charged.
